verdict: Paid campaigns are off; organic activity is holding but softening.

Your Google Business Profile drew 56 actions this period (direction requests, calls, and website clicks), though activity trended down 21% in the most recent week and the last few days showed no recorded actions, which points to softening local visibility. Getting paid campaigns back live is the immediate priority so lead flow can resume.
